support_claim: Identity between crm:OAK-77 and billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH cannot be closed because unresolved-preservation evidence shows no direct cross-system identifier link and a naming gap between the CRM account name and the prior legal designation.

propositions.proposition: CRM account OAK-77 is recorded under the name Oakfield Logistics.
propositions.relevance: Identifies what the left referent crm:OAK-77 denotes in the CRM system.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Establishes that Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal counterparty (rebrand with unchanged registry number).

propositions.proposition: The CRM still shows the old English-facing name for this entity.
propositions.relevance: Links the CRM's English-facing account name to the legal entity described in the rebrand note, bearing on whether crm:OAK-77 refers to the same counterparty as the post-rebrand legal name.

propositions.proposition: Handelsregister entry HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH as active in Germany.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the legal name Oakfield Logistik GmbH in an official registry record associated with the rebrand-described entity.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use the billed name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Identifies what the right referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denotes in the billing system.

propositions.proposition: CRM row OAK-77 records account OAK-77 under the name Oakfield Logistics and does not include HRB 88421 or a billing identifier.
propositions.relevance: No direct cross-system identifier link from crm:OAK-77 to the registry number or billing record appears in this observation; identity depends on intermediate inferences.

propositions.proposition: The rebrand note names the prior legal entity Oakfield Logistics GmbH.
propositions.relevance: The prior legal name includes the GmbH suffix, while the CRM account name for OAK-77 is recorded as Oakfield Logistics without that suffix, leaving whether those designations denote the same registered entity unresolved on identifier grounds alone.
